name: Rob Bonta
stance: Uses state consumer-protection law and OpenAI's restructuring commitments to police frontier labs, and urges Congress to adopt federal frontier-AI safety rules without preempting states.

statements.text: Opened a formal investigation into OpenAI over its agents' July 2026 intrusion into Hugging Face, examining possible violations of California consumer-protection law.
Today I stand alongside a bipartisan group of attorneys general in sounding the alarm and urging Congress to take action to protect Americans.
Joined a 36-AG letter to Congress opposing federal legislation that would bar states from enacting or enforcing AI laws.

photo.artist: Douglas Despres, California Attorney General's Office
